standing: PROPOSED S-OP-2-P, the parent selection of the S-OP-2 recording (S-OP-2 r6 item 24, accepted by Codex as ACCEPT-DESIGN-UNIT; law M3-O1 r1 item 22): direct v4 contract-successor selection of the exact existing SDK4 and DRC bytes that the accepted D-369 application pins, so that item 24's two passage overrides have selected parents. No override, no text change, no schema, application, register, gate or product change. Exact frozen candidate requires actual independent review and root assent.
scope: Selects component-sdk-contract.v4.json (APP /rows/12/inheritedContract, the DR-125 row's inherited contract) and distribution-runtime-completion.v2.md (APP /evidenceTargets/D.SDK/sources/0, the D.SDK selection of section 8) at their own paths with their APP-pinned bytes. Selection binds bytes only: SDK4 keeps its own CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED header, and it and DRC mean exactly what the D-369 application already inherits from them.
carriedLimits: Selecting SDK4 does not apply it: its header still says CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and binds NOTHING; the DR-125 application row inherits it, and only that inheritance is carried.
DRC is selected whole for byte provenance; only its section 8 is the D.SDK selection.
No product, M3 or release qualification.
